message.content: We must ask why they traded with us, since their goods enriched our lands. They believed that such exchanges strengthened their own rule, yet we saw how it shifted power among them. Did not their merchants spread influence? We know that these networks connected distant realms, and they leveraged those links to expand their reach. We should consider whether this helped or harmed the pharaohs, since their authority relied on control. They often used trade to fund temples, yet we wonder if it also weakened local loyalty. We cannot ignore how such flows changed who held power, because resources determined status. They might have gained wealth, but did they lose autonomy? We must reflect on this, for history shows that external ties can reshape internal hierarchies.
